description: One control-mode session (80x24, history-limit 60). After each scenario the driver snapshot batch (snapshotCommands(0) + sentinel) is sent; the flood's batch is sent while output is still arriving.

scenarios.name: alternate screen: scroll region, cursor mid-screen, modes
origin mode, scroll region, tab stops, insert mode, cursor style, focus
wide characters at the edge, emoji, combining marks
